description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the specifications of one or more nodes. Before you change the specifications, ensure that the node resources meet the requirements of the target specifications. If a node does not meet the new specification requirements, the task reports success, but the specifications are not changed. Therefore, do not rely on the task status. To confirm a successful change, query the node after the task is complete and check the returned specifications
description_zh:
节点规格变配。节点规格变配需要用户保证相关节点资源满足目标规格上限。节点规格是否变配成功，以任务结束后再查询节点返回对应的规格为准， 不能以任务是否成功为准。
在发起规格变配请求之后，如果节点不满足规格要求，任务会成功，但是实际不会变配
name: ChangeNodeTypes

parameters.help_en: A list of node IDs. You can specify a maximum of 10 nodes in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 节点列表, 当前限制一批最大10台
parameters.name: node_ids
